translations.literal: Eledengbao (Manchu Plain Yellow Banner. In the first year of Jiaqing, for pacifying the Miao frontier, was enfeoffed as first-rank Marquis Who Commends Martial Valor and Courage. In the twelfth month, for pacifying sectarian bandits in the three provinces, was enfeoffed as first-rank marquis with perpetual succession. In the eighth month of the tenth year was enfeoffed as third-rank Duke Who Commends Martial Valor and Courage; soon died; posthumous name Zhongyi; his son inherited at reduced rank).

translations.literal: Ebilun (younger brother of Tuerge. At first inherited as first-rank viscount, treated separately. In the ninth year was stripped of the granted first-rank duke. Soon restored to first-rank duke rank. Died in the twelfth year; posthumous name Kexi. In the sixteenth year the Kangxi Emperor made his daughter empress, known as Empress Xiaozhaoren).
